title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：origin　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 origin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the writer ① traced the origin that no reader in the study would have counted, and he said the tracing was the whole of the month. The ② origin, meaning the source itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; an origin, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ origin in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ origin at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An origin, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the writer said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the origin was the whole of the matter, meaning the identity and not the source. The ⑥ origin, meaning the identity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; origin, he said, is either something you trace or the only word that means both a source and an identity. He said the identity is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ origin had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ origin of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of counting; origin, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ origin I remember is the source counted in the manuscript, which closed in 1969 and is still counted as the quietest in the study. An ⑩ origin, my mother said in 1971, is the only source that improves by being counted; every origin, she said, is an identity that has agreed to look like a source. She said the identity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 起源；出身（指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 起源；出身（指那个起源本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：trace the origin 追溯这一个起源
D. n. 起源；出身（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 起源之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的起源之事）
F. n. 起源；出身（指手稿里写到、被清点的那一个）
G. n. 起源、来处（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 来处（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: traced the origin that no reader in the study would have counted
The origin, meaning the source itself and not the page
the origin at the far shelf
the origin was the whole of the matter
the origin had become a line in a manuscript
The origin of the whole thing
An origin, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: trace the origin 意为“追溯这一个起源”，1962 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯清点的一个起源做了一遍。
origin 意为“起源；出身”，指那个起源本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
origin 意为“起源；出身”，指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
origin 意为“起源；出身”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
origin 意为“起源、来处”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个来处就是那件事的全部。
origin 意为“来处”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个起源，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
origin 意为“起源；出身”，指手稿里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1967 年这一个成了手稿里的一行。
origin 意为“起源之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的起源之事是一处书斋和三个月份的清点。
origin 意为“起源；出身”，我记得的是手稿里清点过的那一个，1969 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一个。
origin 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，起源是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的起源。
